tasks.gr8-listening-speaking-t1: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 8 Term 1). Cover introductions, daily life discussions, prepared reading, listening comprehension, and classroom interaction. Ask learners to choose polite and relevant spoken responses, identify key details from short oral prompts, and select effective turn-taking and oral-reading strategies.
tasks.gr8-reading-viewing-t1: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 8 Term 1). Cover visual texts, advertisements, short stories, poems, and comprehension strategies. Ask learners to identify main ideas, retrieve supporting details, interpret visual clues, and answer vocabulary-in-context and sequence questions.
tasks.gr8-writing-presenting-t1: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 8 Term 1). Cover narrative paragraphs, descriptive writing, friendly letters, dialogues, and drafting. Ask learners to identify suitable text formats, organise ideas logically, choose effective openings and closings, and improve drafts through editing choices.
tasks.gr8-language-structures-t1: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 8 Term 1). Cover nouns, concords, adjectives, simple tenses, punctuation, and spelling. Ask learners to complete grammar-focused MCQs, choose correct agreement patterns, identify tense forms, and correct punctuation or spelling errors in short sentences.
